title: relay doctor checks every dependency the installer sets up
what: One list of relay's dependencies (name, minimum version, how to check it, how the installer installs it) in a structured file; the installer installs from it and `relay doctor` checks from it: python3 3.11+, git, jq, claude, uv, and the gate tools at their pinned versions (ruff, mypy, pytest); each missing or old one is a FIX line naming the install command.
why: Owner, verbatim: "Добавил ли ты скрипты установки и проверки зависимостей - такие обычно называются установщиками и докторами". relay doctor today checks python3 3.11+, jq and claude, but not git, uv or the gate tools the gate now needs.
where: lib/relay_setup.py doctor, a dependency list file (new)
